B01.subject: Escalation: Invoice CH-7741 for trip TB-49108
B01.body:
Hello,

I'm escalating invoice CH-7741 for your decision. It is from Copperleaf Haulage LLC for $1,600.00 and relates to trip TB-49108.

What conflicts: the carrier that sent the invoice is not the carrier recorded on the trip.

No payment is proposed until you decide how to proceed. Please let me know your decision, and I'll take it from there.

Thank you.

B03.subject: Invoice 60418 (Trip TB-49733): payment adjustment
B03.body:
Hello,

Thank you for invoice 60418 for trip TB-49733, totaling $1,960.00. We are processing $1,810.00 for this invoice.

The difference is due to one line: "Layover - 1 night, receiver closed" is billed at $400.00, but the approved amount for this charge is $250.00. We are paying the approved amount.

If you have written approval for the higher layover amount, please send it and we will review it.

Thank you for your help.

Accounts Payable

B05.subject: Escalation: Invoice RX-0092 for trip TB-49650
B05.body:
Hello,

I'm escalating invoice RX-0092 from Redfennel Express, total $890.00, for trip TB-49650.

What conflicts: the invoicing carrier is not the carrier on the trip.

No payment is proposed until you have decided how to proceed. Please let me know your decision, and I'll act on it from there.

B06.subject: Invoice 3391 on hold – receipt needed for trip TB-49819
B06.body:
Hello,

Thank you for invoice 3391 from Marrowstone Cartage for trip TB-49819, totaling $1,425.00. We have placed the invoice on hold while we complete our review.

The invoice includes a charge for liftgate service, which was approved, but we don't have a receipt for it. Could you please send a receipt for the liftgate service on this trip? Once we have it, we can continue processing the invoice.

Thank you for your help, and please let us know if you have any questions.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable

B08.subject: Invoice SSL-448 (Trip TB-49905) on hold: total needs correction
B08.body:
Hello,

Thank you for invoice SSL-448 for trip TB-49905. We are placing it on hold for now because the invoice lines add up to $1,270.00, but the total shows $1,370.00.

Could you please send a corrected invoice, or let us know in writing which figure is right and why? Once we receive that, we can continue reviewing the invoice.

Thank you for your help.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable

B10.subject: Invoice VR-2207 (Trip TB-49342) needs your decision
B10.body:
Hello,

I am escalating invoice VR-2207 from Vireo Road Freight for trip TB-49342 for your decision.

What conflicts: the base price on the invoice is $1,205.00, while the agreed price on file for this trip is $1,250.00. The invoice total is $1,205.00.

No payment is proposed until you decide. Please let me know how you would like to proceed.

Thank you.

B11.subject: Invoice OB-7015 on hold – trip TB-49960
B11.body:
Hello,

Thank you for sending invoice OB-7015 for $1,095.00 from Otterbow Motor Freight. We are placing it on hold for now because we could not find trip TB-49960 in our records.

To help us move forward, could you please send supporting documentation for trip TB-49960, such as the bill of lading or proof of delivery, along with any booking or reference number we can use to match it?

Once we receive this, we will review the invoice again. Please let us know if you have any questions.

Thank you,
Accounts Payable
